idea-plugin.name: PII Field Annotation Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter warning icon on any Java/Kotlin class field whose name looks like it holds PII (email, ssn, phoneNumber, dateOfBirth, creditCard, passportNumber, nationalId, taxId, and similar) with no annotation of any kind on it -- no way for masking, redaction, or access-control tooling built around annotations to ever pick it up.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches the field name by simple text, and accepts any annotation as "classified" (there's no single standard PII annotation across teams -- a Bean Validation constraint, a Jackson view, a custom @Pii/@Sensitive, anything counts). Java and Kotlin, including Kotlin primary-constructor properties.

Stated honestly: v0.1 covers the most common, unambiguous PII field-name shapes only -- it is not an exhaustive privacy-law taxonomy (GDPR/CCPA "personal data" is far broader and inherently contextual). A field with an unusual name that still holds PII isn't covered.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
